rule: Qualification is sequential; concurrent coding does not imply qualification.

gates.name: Reproducible candidate
gates.exit_evidence: Pinned source, dependency, OS and build identities from exact candidate; independent review still pending

gates.name: Economic conservation
gates.exit_evidence: Trading Lab-owned typed economic events, exact-Decimal cash/position conservation, classified native-to-our-model broker facts, durable restart and independent reconciliation; NautilusTrader only an optional comparative oracle

gates.name: Point-in-time inputs
gates.exit_evidence: As-of source identity, availability timestamps, revisions, membership and corporate-action custody

gates.name: Typed decision and risk
gates.exit_evidence: Typed execution decision; held plus uncertain pending exposure, strict reduce-only and hard kill invariants

gates.name: Durable order lifecycle
gates.exit_evidence: Broker-order acknowledgement != fill; idempotent replay, late cancel/fill races and crash-durable recovery

gates.name: Scientific qualification
gates.exit_evidence: Prospective holdout, selection-aware statistics, causal data/economics and qualified policy fallback

gates.name: Authenticated paper broker
gates.exit_evidence: Authenticated complete broker observations; real PAPER B01-B10 and independent financial reconciliation

gates.name: Operator deployment
gates.exit_evidence: Minimal operator status and halt visibility before broker trials; production hardening, safe upgrade and soak at phase exit

gates.name: Independent release criteria
gates.exit_evidence: Seven independent release gates on same reviewed candidate, all required statuses and hashes

prohibitions: automatic promotion from test to broker
broker authority based on an F0 manifest
F5 statistical approval before F1-F4 qualification
expansion inheriting prior independent release approval
